text: I think you'll really enjoy this Butternut Squash and Chickpea Stew With Couscous recipe. It's a hearty and flavorful dish that fits within your 30-minute time budget. Since you mentioned a liking for pasta, I think you'll appreciate the couscous in this recipe, which serves a similar purpose. The addition of chickpeas and butternut squash soup provides a good amount of protein and fiber, making it a nutritious option. Plus, it's nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any dietary restrictions. Give it a try!
